title: fix: check data dependencies before production promotion
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Make the promotion skill explicitly check changed Tinybird resources in production and block on missing resources or failed probes.
- Verify pending D1 migrations against production history and the existing migrate-before-deploy workflow, including compatibility with the still-running Workers.
- Record both checks in the promotion PR so prerequisite verification is visible to reviewers.
- Checked against the current production workflow and Tinybird deployment rules; `git diff --check` passes. Instruction-only change; no deployments.

gist.headline: The gate checks the roots
gist.blurb: Production promotions now pause to inspect their Tinybird roots and D1 migration trail. Less guessing at the garden gate, more proof the soil is there.
gist.summary: Updated the production-promotion skill to verify changed Tinybird resources and probes in production, check pending D1 migrations against production history and the migrate-before-deploy workflow, and record both results in the promotion PR.
gist.impact: Reviewers now get visible prerequisite checks for Tinybird and D1 before a production promotion proceeds, helping deployments stay compatible with running Workers.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden gate represents the production-promotion checkpoint: Polli, wearing a tiny safety helmet and clipboard, checks a glowing Tinybird data plant and a migration-map scroll before opening the gate. A small CRT monitor robot displays green checkmarks, with roots and flowers emphasizing dependency checks.

Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, dark purple (#110518) outlines, flowers and vines around the gate, emotionally warm and nostalgic.
